title: Golden Harvest Comfort

diffuser.notes: Add to a diffuser with water for a cozy, spicy-sweet aroma.

spray_optional.note: Shake well before each use; spray in air or on linens.

why_it_works: Sweet orange and cinnamon evoke warm harvest bounty, while clove adds spicy depth and cedarwood grounds the blend with earthy calm—perfect for settling into autumn evenings.
safety: Patch test; dilute for skin (2% roller).
Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
